headline: AI Giants Race Reshapes Research Tech Landscape—OpenAI and Google Escalate Competition
bottomLine: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and Google's aggressive AI investments signal an acceleration in generative AI capabilities that will force research platforms to rapidly integrate advanced AI features or risk obsolescence in the Belgian market.
keyFindings: OpenAI and Google are making unprecedented AI bets, intensifying competition in large language models and research-adjacent AI applications that directly threaten traditional research tool incumbents.
